citation: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation), OJ L 119, 4.5.2016, p. 1; corrigendum OJ L 127, 23.5.2018, p. 2
authority: The European Parliament and the Council of the European Union
extent: European Union (Article 3: processing in the context of the activities of an establishment of a controller or processor in the Union, and the cases of Article 3(2) and (3) for controllers and processors not established there)

source.provider: Publications Office of the European Union (cellar)
source.note: Three deposited texts in registers/source-bundle/: the Regulation as published (4.5.2016, uncorrected, with the recitals), the corrigendum of 23.5.2018, and the Publications Office consolidated version of 4.5.2016 (CELEX 02016R0679-20160504), which applies the corrigendum and has no recitals. The consolidated text is the one quoted for Articles 1 to 99 and the as-published text the one for the recitals, which are reading aids and are not encoded: assumed, not ruled. The 2016 and 2021 corrigenda were not retrievable from the cellar and are not deposited; the 2021 one is reported not to concern the English version, which was not read at source. No amending act was found; Regulation (EU) 2025/2518 (procedural rules for cross-border cases, applies from 2 April 2027) supplements the Regulation and does not amend it, and the Digital Omnibus proposal is a proposal only, so neither is encoded.
